data_window: 2026-08-28 00:00 to 2026-08-31 10:45 Asia/Shanghai. GitHub Search API batches covered newly created and recently pushed AI agent, LLM app, MCP agent, browser agent, code agent, RAG agent, voice agent, AI workflow and automation-agent repositories. Raw responses were saved under /tmp/radar_2026_08_31_*.json; selected GitHub repository metadata, root contents and README audits were saved under /tmp/radar_2026_08_31_repos/ and /tmp/radar_2026_08_31_readmes/.
source_summary: git fetch origin succeeded on main...origin/main. Pre-existing unrelated frontend/deploy dirty files and old untracked data/runs/2026-08-19-lark-message.md were preserved unstaged. Discovery used unauthenticated GitHub Search API metadata plus selected GitHub API repository/root-content and raw README downloads. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, run, browser-tested, desktop-tested, mobile-tested, MCP-handshake-tested, credential-tested, provider-tested, payment-tested, security-scanned or deployed.
trend_observations: The strongest cluster today is agent operations infrastructure: local-first control planes for many coding agents, task intake hubs, browser/desktop action bridges, delivery-evidence gates, loop guards, verified memory and agent-safe secrets. New products are less about another chatbot and more about making agent work observable, bounded, repeatable and connected to the user's existing browser, notes, inboxes, logs and credentials.
assumptions: Scores are editorial point-in-time rankings based on GitHub Search API metadata, README evidence, root file structure, install/build cues, documentation completeness, repository freshness and AI-native workflow depth. Stars/forks are unauthenticated API snapshots, not exact growth deltas. README claims were not independently runtime-verified. Mature platforms already seen in earlier radar runs were downgraded unless today's update exposed a materially new product angle. Pure skill collections, paper/research-first repos, prompt lists, thin utilities, generic media tools and marketing-only repos were downgraded or skipped; type-level skip reasons are kept in Markdown instead of being fabricated as GitHub repo entries.

skipped_projects.skip_reason: Useful agent-skill collection for data engineering, but it is primarily a curated skill pack rather than a runnable product surface.
Academic-paper review prototype is relevant but closer to paper/RAG workflow demo; defer until runnability and review-quality evidence are stronger.
Apple Silicon MiniMax-H3/video-generation suite and agent skill is hardware/model-specific and benchmark-heavy; product surface is less general for today.
Hermes social posting skills have a clear workflow but only a small skills folder/root surface; social account posting risk requires more audit before promotion.
Browser copilot extension has a runnable Vite/TypeScript surface but 0-star metadata and marketing-heavy README made it lower confidence than RZN/frago.
Cloud GraphRAG blueprint has Docker/frontend/backend evidence, but it reads more like reference architecture than a finished AI-native product.
Agent quota HUD is product-shaped, but narrower and less evidenced than Envault/Loop Guard/Gnosis for today.
AI novel-writing IDE appears product-shaped, but it is a fork of OrisonSpace and outside today's agent-ops focus.
